name: team-troops
title: Team Troops Section
blurb: Elements blur in and cascade down as they enter the viewport.
description: Wraps children in a motion container that animates blur, opacity, and Y position with staggered delays when they come into view. Uses Framer Motion's viewport tracking.
use_when: Showing process steps or timeline sequence where each stage needs staged reveal emphasis.
avoid_when: Rapid scrolling or touch-only surfaces where viewport detection is imprecise.
a11y: Wrapper only; focus handling not managed. Motion plays on viewport entry via useInView, respects custom variants.
